Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / H2 – What are KOLs and KOCs
English: What are KOLs and KOCs?
Chinese: KOL和KOC到底是什么

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph – KOL definition
English: KOL stands for Key Opinion Leader. These are the established names. Millions of followers, high production quality, strong personal brands. They charge upfront fees plus sales commissions. The best ones are booked months out.
Chinese: KOL全称Key Opinion Leader，关键意见领袖。就是那些成名的达人，百万级粉丝，制作精良，个人品牌强势。他们的报价是坑位费加销售分成。顶流基本几个月前就排满了档期。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph – KOC definition
English: KOC stands for Key Opinion Consumer. Everyday users with smaller followings, usually between 1,000 and 100,000. They post product reviews, unboxing clips, and personal recommendations. The content is less polished and it tends to feel more honest.
Chinese: KOC全称Key Opinion Consumer，关键意见消费者。就是普通用户，粉丝量大多在1000到10万之间。他们发产品测评、开箱、亲身推荐。内容不精致，但显得更真诚。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph – Both play a role
English: Both play a role in how brands grow in China. The question is which one to use, when, and how much to spend on each.
Chinese: 两类人在品牌的中国增长里都有位置。问题只是什么时候用谁，以及各投多少钱。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / H2 – Why this distinction matters
English: Why this distinction matters
Chinese: 为什么这个区别重要

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Why this distinction matters' / 1
English: In China's influencer ecosystem, the difference between KOLs and KOCs goes well beyond follower count. It is about how audiences respond to the content.
Chinese: 在中国的达人生态里，KOL和KOC的区别远远不止粉丝量。真正的差别在受众怎么反应。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Why this distinction matters' / 2
English: According to iiMedia Research, KOC influence on consumer purchasing decisions ranks just behind KOLs and well above celebrities or general internet personalities. It comes down to trust. KOC content reads like a recommendation from someone in your circle. KOL content, even when it is well made, reads like a paid endorsement.
Chinese: 艾媒咨询的数据显示，KOC对消费者购买决策的影响力紧跟KOL，明显超过明星和泛娱乐网红。核心是信任。KOC的内容读起来像朋友圈里某个熟人的推荐。KOL的内容再精，也像一条广告。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Why this distinction matters' / 3
English: Younger consumers are especially skeptical. Gen Z audiences in China increasingly question sponsored content. That does not mean KOLs are useless. But the era of dumping your entire budget on one big name and hoping for results is mostly behind us.
Chinese: 年轻一代尤其敏感。中国的Z世代越来越不信种草稿。这不代表KOL没用了。但"一把预算砸一个大号就能出效果"的年代已经过去了。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / H2 – The fake follower problem
English: The fake follower problem
Chinese: 虚假粉丝这件事

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Fake follower' / 1
English: This is the part most people in the industry know about but do not discuss openly enough.
Chinese: 这是行业里人人知道、但没人好好聊的话题。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Fake follower' / 2
English: An MCN insider told Rancaijing that only 10-20% of the KOLs managed by his company had completely organic reach. The rest relied on paid amplification to inflate their metrics.
Chinese: 某MCN机构的内部人士对《燃财经》说，他公司旗下只有10%到20%的KOL是真实流量的，剩下的基本都靠付费推流或者数据注水撑起来。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Blockquote – CCTV investigation
English: CCTV News investigated this supply chain in 2019 and documented how cheap it is to manufacture fake engagement on Chinese social platforms.
Chinese: 央视新闻早在2019年就对这条灰产做过调查，揭露了在中国社交平台上制造假互动的成本有多低。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Fake follower' / 3
English: Creating a fake 100,000+ view count on a post can cost under 1,000 yuan. For brands investing tens of thousands per campaign, the risk of partnering with inflated accounts is not theoretical. It happens all the time in this market.
Chinese: 一条爆文看起来有10万+阅读，背后可能只花了不到1000元。品牌一次投放动辄几万几十万，踩到注水账号的风险不是理论问题，几乎每天都在发生。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Fake follower' / 4
English: This is why verification matters more than raw numbers. Engagement rate, comment quality, audience demographics, and purchasing behavior data tell you far more than the follower count on someone's profile page.
Chinese: 所以核验比数字重要。互动率、评论质量、粉丝画像和购买行为数据，比主页上的那个粉丝数字可信得多。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Fake follower' / 5
English: Platforms are getting better at detecting this. Xiaohongshu's Pugongying platform and Douyin's Xingtu both provide audience authenticity data when brands book influencers through official channels. But off-platform deals with no verification still happen constantly.
Chinese: 平台自己也在收紧。小红书的蒲公英平台和抖音的星图都已经提供粉丝真实性数据，品牌通过官方渠道下单时可以查。但平台外的私下合作依然一大堆，没有任何核验可言。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / H2 – How brands layer KOLs and KOCs
English: How brands layer KOLs and KOCs together
Chinese: 品牌是怎么把KOL和KOC搭起来的

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How brands layer' / 1
English: The most effective approach in China is layered. The industry calls it the "pyramid" model.
Chinese: 在中国做得最好的打法叫"金字塔模型"。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How brands layer' / 2
English: Perfect Diary helped popularize this strategy around 2020-2021. According to data from GrowthBox, their influencer investment on Xiaohongshu roughly followed this ratio: 1 celebrity, 1 top KOL, 3 head-level creators, 46 mid-tier, 100 entry-level, and 150 KOCs.
Chinese: 大约在2020-2021年，完美日记把这套打法普及开来。Growthbox的数据显示，完美日记在小红书上的达人投入比例大致是：明星1、头部KOL 1、腰部3、中腰部46、初级100、KOC 150。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How brands layer' / 3
English: Each layer does a different job. Top KOLs set the conversation and generate initial buzz. Mid-tier creators go deeper in specific product niches. KOCs push authentic content across communities and give hesitant buyers the final nudge.
Chinese: 每一层的作用都不同。头部KOL定调、起势；腰部KOL深挖细分品类；KOC在各种圈子里生产真实内容，给犹豫的消费者最后一把火。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How brands layer' / 4
English: The model has evolved since then. In 2025, the mid-tier layer has become the most important. During the Double 11 shopping festival, mid-tier hosts with annual sales of 1-10 billion yuan contributed 45% of total live commerce GMV, with an average single-session ROI of 1:8.
Chinese: 这套模型这几年也在演化。到了2025年，腰部是最吃香的一层。双十一期间，年销1-10亿元的腰部主播贡献了直播电商GMV的45%，单场平均ROI达到1:8。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Source citation 1
English: Source: 100EC.cn, 2025 Double 11 Data Report
Chinese: 来源：网经社，《2025双十一数据报告》

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How brands layer' / 5
English: Meanwhile, the market share of top-tier mega KOLs dipped from 32% to 30%, reflecting a deliberate push by platforms toward decentralized traffic distribution.
Chinese: 与此同时，头部超级KOL的份额从32%下滑到30%，这是平台主动推动流量去中心化的结果。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How brands layer' / 6
English: Right now, the middle of the pyramid is where the best return sits.
Chinese: 现在最能打的一层，就是金字塔的腰部。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / H2 – How influencers get paid
English: How influencers get paid
Chinese: 达人怎么收钱

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How influencers get paid' / 1
English: Payment structures depend on the tier.
Chinese: 结算方式按层级分。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Bullet – Top KOLs payment
English: Top KOLs negotiate a flat booking fee per appearance, plus a percentage of sales. For live commerce, this hybrid model is how the biggest names work. The fee secures time on their schedule. The commission keeps incentives aligned.
Chinese: 头部KOL 基本是坑位费加CPS。直播电商领域，头部清一色这么干。坑位费锁时间，分成绑效果。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Bullet – Mid-tier KOLs payment
English: Mid-tier KOLs work on smaller flat fees plus CPS. Some accept pure commission if the brand or product is strong enough to drive volume on its own.
Chinese: 腰部KOL 的坑位费少一些，也是加CPS。如果品牌或产品本身够硬，他们也接纯佣合作。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Bullet – KOCs payment
English: KOCs mostly work on pure commission or receive free products in exchange for content. At scale, platforms coordinate KOC campaigns through group leader systems with a service fee plus per-sale commission.
Chinese: KOC 大多是纯佣或者纯置换，也就是拿样品换内容。规模化做的时候，平台会通过"团长"体系组织KOC，按"服务费+销售佣金"结算。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Table header – Payment
English: Influencer tier | Typical payment model
Chinese: 达人层级 | 常见结算方式

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Table row – Top KOL
English: Top KOL or celebrity | Flat fee + CPS commission
Chinese: 头部KOL或明星 | 坑位费 + CPS分成

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Table row – Mid-tier KOL
English: Mid-tier KOL | Smaller flat fee + CPS
Chinese: 腰部KOL | 小坑位费 + CPS

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Table row – Entry-level KOL
English: Entry-level KOL | CPS only or low flat fee
Chinese: 初级KOL | 纯CPS或低坑位费

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Table row – KOC
English: KOC | Free product + CPS or pure CPS
Chinese: KOC | 置换产品 + CPS 或纯CPS

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph – Commission rates
English: Commission rates range by category. Beauty and skincare sit at 10-25%. Fashion at 8-15%. Electronics at 3-8%. Luxury is highly negotiable, typically 5-15% plus a fixed fee.
Chinese: 佣金比例因品类而异。美妆护肤10-25%；服饰8-15%；数码3-8%；奢侈品通常5-15%再加固定费用，谈判空间大。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / H2 – Brand self-broadcasting
English: Brand self-broadcasting is growing fast
Chinese: 品牌自播增速极快

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Brand self-broadcasting' / 1
English: One of the biggest shifts in 2025 is that brands are building their own livestream operations instead of relying entirely on external KOLs.
Chinese: 2025年最大的变化之一是，品牌开始自建直播团队，不再完全依赖外部KOL。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Brand self-broadcasting' / 2
English: During the 2025 Double 11, brand self-broadcasting accounted for 40% of total live commerce GMV, up 8 points from 2024. Companies like Anta, L'Oreal, and Xiaomi have in-house livestream teams of 50+ people running daily broadcasts.
Chinese: 2025年双十一，品牌自播贡献了直播电商GMV的40%，比2024年提高了8个百分点。安踏、欧莱雅、小米这类公司都有50人以上的自播团队，每天不间断开播。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Source citation 2
English: Source: 100EC.cn
Chinese: 来源：网经社

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Brand self-broadcasting' / 3
English: Some brands now generate more revenue from self-broadcasting than from all their KOL partnerships combined.
Chinese: 有些品牌现在自播的收入已经超过所有KOL合作加起来的总和。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'Brand self-broadcasting' / 4
English: For international brands, this means you have options. You do not need to start with expensive KOL deals. You can build a self-broadcasting operation that gives you control over messaging, better margins, and a direct channel to your audience. The tradeoff is that it takes real investment: studio, hosts, content production, and ad spend to drive viewers.
Chinese: 对国际品牌来说，这意味着你多了一条路径。不必从昂贵的KOL合作开始。可以先搭自播团队，牢牢掌控话语权，毛利也更好，还能直接和受众对话。代价是得真金白银地投入：直播间、主播、内容产出、拉流广告费，一样都不能少。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / H2 – How to think about budget
English: How to think about budget
Chinese: 预算怎么分

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How to think about budget' / 1
English: The right mix depends on where you are.
Chinese: 什么阶段做什么事。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How to think about budget' / 2
English: Brands entering China for the first time usually get the best results starting with KOC seeding on Xiaohongshu. Product gifting, honest reviews, authentic short videos. Build a base of organic proof before spending big on KOLs. This is also the cheapest way to test what messaging resonates.
Chinese: 第一次进中国的品牌，最有性价比的起点是在小红书上做KOC种草。送样、真实测评、短视频。先攒一圈原生口碑，再考虑砸KOL预算。这也是测消费者信息点反馈最便宜的方式。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How to think about budget' / 3
English: Brands already in China and looking to scale should focus on 2-3 mid-tier KOLs in their specific product category. Structured campaigns with clear briefs, not scattered one-off posts. Mid-tier KOLs give you the best ratio of cost to conversion right now.
Chinese: 已经在中国站稳脚跟、准备扩大的品牌，重点投2-3位自己品类的腰部KOL。要结构化的campaign，要明确的brief，不是零散一次性的投放。当下腰部的转化效率比是最划算的。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How to think about budget' / 4
English: Brands going all in should build the full pyramid and start investing in self-broadcasting. That combination of external reach and owned live commerce is what is working best heading into 2026.
Chinese: 想全力all in的品牌，就把整个金字塔搭起来，同时开始砸自播。外部KOL的声量加上自有直播间的转化，这是2026年进入之前最灵的组合。

Location: Blog / KOL vs KOC / Paragraph under 'How to think about budget' / 5
English: And regardless of budget: verify every influencer before you sign. The number on someone's profile page is the least reliable data point in this entire ecosystem.
Chinese: 不管预算多少，一条铁律：签约之前，先把人核验一遍。主页上的那个数字，是整个生态里最不可靠的一项数据。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Title
English: Live commerce in China: why it converts and how it works
Chinese: 直播电商：中国转化率最高的渠道是怎么跑起来的

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Description
English: Live commerce is China's highest-converting sales channel. Here is how the ecosystem works, what it costs, and why your brand should care.
Chinese: 直播电商是中国转化效率最高的销售渠道。生态怎么搭、费用怎么算、品牌该怎么看，一次讲清。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Meta title
English: Live commerce in China explained
Chinese: 一文讲透中国的直播电商

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Meta description
English: Live commerce drives 65-70% of influencer sales in China. Conversion rates, commissions, MCNs, and what brands should know before spending.
Chinese: 直播电商在中国撬动了65-70%的达人带货销售额。转化率、分佣模式、MCN以及品牌投放前必须知道的事。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Category
English: Strategy
Chinese: 策略

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Keywords
English: live commerce China, livestream selling, China e-commerce, MCN China, CPS commission, Taobao Live, Douyin e-commerce
Chinese: 中国直播电商, 直播带货, 中国电商, 中国MCN, CPS分成, 淘宝直播, 抖音电商

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Intro italic
English: The highest-converting sales channel in China's digital ecosystem is not a website, an app store, or a social media feed. It is a livestream.
Chinese: 在中国的数字生态里，转化率最高的销售渠道不是官网，不是应用商店，也不是社交信息流。是一场直播。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / H2 – How big is live commerce
English: How big is live commerce in China?
Chinese: 直播电商到底有多大

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'How big' / 1
English: China's live commerce market hit 4.9 trillion yuan in total transaction value in 2023, growing at over 35% year over year.
Chinese: 2023年，中国直播电商市场交易额达到4.9万亿元，同比增速超过35%。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'How big' / 2
English: By 2025, the broader online retail market was projected to reach 16.65 trillion yuan, with live streaming as its fastest-growing segment.
Chinese: 到2025年，广义的线上零售市场预计达到16.65万亿元，直播是其中增速最快的分支。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Source citation 1
English: Source: iiMedia Research, 2025 China Livestream E-commerce Industry Report
Chinese: 来源：艾媒咨询，《2025中国直播电商行业研究报告》

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'How big' / 3
English: During the 2025 Double 11 shopping festival, knowledge-based livestreams grew 180% compared to the year before. Average viewer dwell time reached 28 minutes. Conversion rates on those streams hit 9.2%.
Chinese: 2025年双十一期间，知识型直播同比增长180%。平均观看时长达到28分钟。这类直播间的转化率冲到9.2%。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Source citation 2
English: Source: 100EC.cn, 2025 Double 11 Data Report
Chinese: 来源：网经社，《2025双十一数据报告》

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'How big' / 4
English: Traditional e-commerce browsing converts at roughly 0.5-1.5%. So live commerce is running at about 6x that.
Chinese: 传统电商浏览购买的转化率大约在0.5%-1.5%之间。直播电商是它的6倍。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / H2 – Why it converts
English: Why it converts
Chinese: 转化为什么这么强

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Why it converts' / 1
English: A livestream session works like a product demo, a Q&A, and a flash sale running at the same time. The host shows the product, takes viewer questions in real time, and offers pricing that is only available during the broadcast.
Chinese: 一场直播同时完成三件事：产品演示、现场答疑和限时促销。主播上手展示产品，实时回答观众问题，再给一个"只限直播间"的价格。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Why it converts' / 2
English: Viewers buy during the stream. Not later. A trusted host answering questions live, other buyers purchasing in real time, and a price that expires when the broadcast ends. That mix creates urgency you cannot get from a product page.
Chinese: 观众就在直播间里下单，不会拖到以后。被信任的主播答疑、其他观众同时下单、过时作废的价格——这套组合制造出静态商品页给不了的紧迫感。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Why it converts' / 3
English: Overall live commerce conversion rates sit between 3% and 8%. Top hosts regularly hit 10-15%. Short video reviews convert at 1.5-3%. Social media posts sit at 0.5-1.5%.
Chinese: 整体直播电商的转化率在3%-8%。头部主播常年能做到10%-15%。短视频测评的转化率在1.5%-3%之间。社交图文帖子大概是0.5%-1.5%。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Blockquote – Double 11 beauty
English: During the 2025 Double 11, beauty brands saw particularly strong results. "Ingredient-focused" livestreams with hosts who had medical or chemistry backgrounds drove a 55% increase in efficacy skincare sales.
Chinese: 2025年双十一期间，美妆品类的表现尤其亮眼。以成分为核心、主播有医学或化学背景的"成分型"直播带动功效护肤品销售增长55%。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Source citation 3
English: Source: 100EC.cn, 2025 Double 11 Data Report
Chinese: 来源：网经社，《2025双十一数据报告》

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Why it converts' / 4
English: That gap between channels is large enough that it explains why live commerce now dominates how products actually sell through influencers in China.
Chinese: 这个转化差距大到足以解释：为什么在中国，达人带货的销售几乎都跑到了直播间。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / H2 – The three-part ecosystem
English: The three-part ecosystem
Chinese: 生态由三方组成

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Ecosystem' / 1
English: Live commerce runs on three players: marketplaces, influencers, and MCNs.
Chinese: 直播电商跑起来，靠三个角色：平台、达人和MCN。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Bullet – Marketplaces
English: Marketplaces like Taobao, JD.com, Douyin E-commerce, and Kuaishou provide the infrastructure. They process transactions, handle logistics, and run creator platforms that onboard, rank, and certify influencers.
Chinese: 平台 像淘宝、京东、抖音电商和快手，提供基础设施：交易、物流、达人入驻和分层认证。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Bullet – Influencers
English: Influencers create the content and host the streams. They range from mega KOLs with tens of millions of followers down to micro creators with 10,000 to 100,000.
Chinese: 达人 负责内容创作和开播。上至几千万粉丝的超级KOL，下至几万粉丝的微型主播。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Bullet – MCNs
English: MCNs (Multi-Channel Networks) sit in the middle. They recruit influencers, negotiate brand deals, handle compliance, and coordinate campaigns. MCNs manage an estimated 70-80% of mid-to-top tier influencers. The MCN market reached 63.6 billion yuan in 2024.
Chinese: MCN 机构夹在中间。他们负责签约达人、接洽品牌、处理合规、统筹campaign。估计中腰部以上的达人大约70-80%挂在MCN旗下。2024年MCN市场规模达到636亿元。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Source citation 4
English: Source: iiMedia Research
Chinese: 来源：艾媒咨询

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Ecosystem' / 2
English: Micro-influencers often operate independently. But for brands running paid live commerce campaigns at any real scale, MCN partnerships are the standard path.
Chinese: 微小达人常常单打独斗。但任何稍有规模的付费直播campaign，MCN合作都是主流路径。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / H2 – Commission models
English: Commission models
Chinese: 分佣模式

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Commission models' / 1
English: Three payment structures drive the economics. The most common is CPS (Cost Per Sale), used in 80-90% of campaigns. The influencer earns a percentage of each sale after discounts and refunds. Low-risk for brands because you only pay when someone buys.
Chinese: 三种结算方式撑起整个生意。最常见的是CPS（按销售分成），80-90%的投放都是这种。主播拿每笔成交扣除退款后的分成。对品牌来说风险低，只有卖出去才付钱。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Commission models' / 2
English: CPA (Cost Per Action) pays a flat amount for specific actions like app downloads or signups. It shows up more in awareness campaigns on social channels rather than live commerce.
Chinese: CPA（按动作付费）是为下载、注册这类具体行为付固定价。更多出现在品宣类campaign，不在直播电商里。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Commission models' / 3
English: Top KOLs and high-profile livestream hosts typically work on a hybrid model: a flat booking fee to secure their time, plus CPS commission on top. This is how the biggest names operate.
Chinese: 头部KOL和知名主播则通常是混合模式：一笔坑位费锁住他的时间段，再加CPS分成。头部主播基本都这么玩。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Commission models' / 4
English: Rates vary by product category:
Chinese: 佣金比例因品类而异：

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Table header – Commission
English: Category | Commission range
Chinese: 品类 | 佣金区间

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Table row – Beauty
English: Beauty and skincare | 10-25%

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Table row – Fashion
English: Fashion and apparel | 8-15%

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Table row – FMCG
English: FMCG and food | 5-12%
Chinese: 快消和食品 | 5-12%

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Table row – Electronics
English: Electronics and tech | 3-8%
Chinese: 数码电子 | 3-8%

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Table row – Luxury
English: Luxury goods | 5-15% (plus fixed fees)
Chinese: 奢侈品 | 5-15%（另加固定费用）

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Commission models' / 5
English: Platforms like Taobao Union and Douyin Select Alliance automate the tracking and payouts. They take roughly a 10% service fee on commissions.
Chinese: 淘宝联盟和抖音精选联盟这些平台会自动跟踪和结算。它们从分佣里抽大约10%的服务费。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / H2 – AI behind the scenes
English: AI behind the scenes
Chinese: AI在幕后做了什么

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'AI behind the scenes' / 1
English: AI is not replacing livestream hosts. But it is reshaping what happens before and during broadcasts.
Chinese: AI并没有取代主播。但它在重写每场直播前后发生的一切。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'AI behind the scenes' / 2
English: According to a report from Chinabaogao, one beauty host used an AI-generated content library and cut her per-product explanation from 5 minutes to 2.5 minutes. Her GMV conversion rate went up 40%.
Chinese: Chinabaogao的报告显示，一位美妆主播用AI生成的内容素材库，把每个产品的讲解时间从5分钟压到2.5分钟。直播间GMV转化率提升了40%。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'AI behind the scenes' / 3
English: Script preparation is where the time really goes. A single livestream covering 80 products requires roughly 24 hours of writing. AI tools now generate product talking points, compliance checks, and creative variations in a fraction of that time. By most accounts, the majority of active livestream rooms in China now use AI for at least part of their content prep.
Chinese: 时间真正烧在脚本准备上。一场讲80个产品的直播，脚本大约要写24小时。AI工具现在能在一小部分时间里生成产品卖点、合规话术和创意变体。行业里多数活跃直播间，已经在用AI打理至少一部分内容准备。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'AI behind the scenes' / 4
English: AI digital hosts are part of the picture too. JD.com's virtual host ran a 24-hour health products stream that reached a 22.6% conversion rate. These digital hosts work best for overnight shifts and standardized product demos. Prime-time slots still belong to humans.
Chinese: AI数字人主播也正在入场。京东的虚拟主播在一场24小时健康品类直播里跑到了22.6%的转化率。这类数字人最适合夜间时段和标准化产品演示。黄金时段还是属于真人。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Blockquote – Kuaishou AI
English: On Kuaishou alone, AI-generated creative assets now exceed 30 million daily in consumption.
Chinese: 单在快手一家，AI生成的创意素材日消耗量已经超过3000万条。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Source citation 5
English: Source: CIECC, Livestream E-commerce High-Quality Development Report
Chinese: 来源：中国国际电子商务中心，《直播电商高质量发展报告》

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'AI behind the scenes' / 5
English: Same pattern across the whole industry: AI handles volume and speed. Humans handle trust.
Chinese: 整个行业都是同一个规律：AI负责量和速度，人负责信任。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / H2 – Common mistakes
English: Common mistakes
Chinese: 常见的坑

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Common mistakes' / 1
English: Most international brands treat live commerce like a one-off experiment. One session, one host, see what happens.
Chinese: 大多数国际品牌把直播电商当一次性实验。开一场，找一位主播，看看反应。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Common mistakes' / 2
English: That almost never works. Live commerce is a system, not an event. It requires consistent scheduling, the right host matched to your product category, proper product selection, and paid ad support to actually get viewers into the room.
Chinese: 这样几乎永远跑不出来。直播电商是一套系统，不是一次事件。它要求稳定的排期、匹配品类的主播、严谨的选品，还要付费广告把观众导进直播间。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Common mistakes' / 3
English: The investment level has gone up too. During Double 11 2025, brands spent an average of 250,000 yuan per major livestream, up from 150,000 yuan the previous year. Professional lighting, audio, and set design are now standard.
Chinese: 投入门槛也上来了。2025年双十一期间，品牌头部直播的单场平均投入达到25万元，而上一年只有15万元。专业灯光、音响和场景布置已经是标配。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Source citation 6
English: Source: 100EC.cn
Chinese: 来源：网经社

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Common mistakes' / 4
English: There is also the self-broadcasting trend. Brand-owned livestreams accounted for 40% of total live commerce GMV during Double 11 2025, up 8 points from the year before. Companies like Anta, L'Oreal, and Xiaomi now run in-house teams of 50+ people doing daily broadcasts. Some of these brands generate more revenue from their own streams than from working with external KOLs.
Chinese: 自播也是不能忽略的趋势。2025年双十一，品牌自播占到直播电商GMV的40%，比前一年上涨8个百分点。安踏、欧莱雅、小米这类品牌已经搭起50人以上的自播团队，每天不间断开播。有些品牌自播的营收，已经超过所有外部KOL合作加起来的总和。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'Common mistakes' / 5
English: Treat this as a side project and you will get side-project results.
Chinese: 把它当副业做，你就只能拿到副业级的结果。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / H2 – The bottom line
English: The bottom line
Chinese: 最后一句话

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'The bottom line' / 1
English: Live commerce is the highest-converting channel in China. It is also the most complex. The influencer, the MCN, the marketplace, the commission structure, the content production, the ad spend to fill the room. All of it needs to work.
Chinese: 直播电商是中国转化率最高的渠道，也是最复杂的一个。达人、MCN、平台、分佣结构、内容生产、把人拉进直播间的广告预算——每一环都要跑通。

Location: Blog / Live Commerce in China / Paragraph under 'The bottom line' / 2
English: For brands serious about revenue in China, this is not optional anymore. It is where the money is.
Chinese: 对认真打算在中国做营收的品牌来说，这件事不是"要不要做"的选项题。钱就在这里。

English: WeChat advertising: every ad format and what they actually cost
Chinese: 微信广告全指南：每一种广告形式和真实价格

English: WeChat advertising runs across Moments, Official Accounts, Channels, Mini Programs, and Search. Here is what each format costs and how to start.
Chinese: 微信广告覆盖朋友圈、公众号、视频号、小程序和搜一搜。每一种形式的价格和启动方式一次讲清。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / MetaTitle
English: WeChat ads: every format and what they cost
Chinese: 微信广告：形式全解和真实价格

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / MetaDescription
English: WeChat has six ad formats and three pricing models. Here is what each placement costs and how international brands should plan their first campaign.
Chinese: 微信广告有六种形式和三种计价方式。每个位置花多少钱，国际品牌第一次投放要怎么规划？

English: Platforms

English: WeChat advertising, WeChat Moments ads, WeChat Channels ads, Tencent Ads, China advertising, WeChat CPM, WeChat ad formats
Chinese: 微信广告, 朋友圈广告, 视频号广告, 腾讯广告, 中国广告, 微信CPM, 微信广告形式

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Intro italic
English: Six placements, three pricing models, and a minimum spend that trips up most international brands. A practical guide to WeChat's ad system.
Chinese: 六个位置、三种计价方式、再加一个会把多数国际品牌拦在门外的最低预算。一份实战指南。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H2 – Why WeChat ads work differently
English: Why WeChat ads work differently
Chinese: 微信广告为什么不一样

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'Why WeChat ads work differently' / 1
English: WeChat has over 1.4 billion monthly active users who spend an average of 80 minutes per day inside the app. But unlike Douyin or RedNote, where ads compete for attention in a fast-scrolling discovery feed, WeChat ads land inside a closed, trust-based environment. Your Moments ad sits between posts from the user's friends and family. Your Official Account ad appears inside an article they chose to read.
Chinese: 微信有超过14亿月活用户，平均每天在这个App上花80分钟。但和抖音、小红书那种在高速滑动的发现流里竞争注意力的广告不同，微信广告落在一个封闭、高信任度的环境里。朋友圈广告夹在好友和家人的动态之间。公众号广告出现在用户自己选择阅读的文章里。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'Why WeChat ads work differently' / 2
English: That makes WeChat advertising more precise than most platforms. It also means the bar for creative quality is higher. If your ad does not feel like it belongs in someone's personal feed, it will not perform.
Chinese: 这让微信广告比多数平台都更精准。同时也意味着，对创意质量的要求更高。如果你的广告不像一条能出现在别人动态里的内容，它就跑不出来。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Blockquote under 'Why WeChat ads work differently'
English: WeChat is not the platform for viral reach. It is the platform for reaching the right people, in the right context, with content that belongs there.
Chinese: 微信不是做病毒式传播的平台。它是在合适的语境下，用合适的内容，触达合适的人。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'Why WeChat ads work differently' / 3
English: All WeChat advertising runs through the Tencent Ads platform. You need a verified WeChat Official Account to run any ads. No account, no campaigns. And verification requires a Chinese business entity or an authorized local representative.
Chinese: 所有微信广告都通过腾讯广告平台下单。投放需要一个已认证的微信公众号，没有账号就没有投放。认证还需要一个中国境内的经营主体，或者授权的本地代理。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H2 – The six ad placements
English: The six ad placements
Chinese: 六种广告位

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'The six ad placements' / 1
English: WeChat offers six advertising positions. They are spread across the ecosystem and each one does something slightly different.
Chinese: 微信一共有六种广告位，分散在整个生态里，每一种都有不一样的用处。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Moments Ads
English: Moments Ads | In the user's personal feed, styled like a friend's post | Brand awareness, product launches, major campaigns
Chinese: 朋友圈广告 | 用户朋友圈信息流，形式接近好友发的动态 | 品牌声量、新品发布、大型campaign

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Official Account Ads
English: Official Account Ads | Article bottom, mid-article, video pre-roll | Content-led conversion, follower growth
Chinese: 公众号广告 | 文章底部、文中、视频贴片 | 内容驱动转化、涨粉

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Mini Program Ads
English: Mini Program Ads | Banners, interstitials, rewarded video inside Mini Programs | E-commerce, app installs, gaming
Chinese: 小程序广告 | 小程序里的横幅、插屏、激励视频 | 电商、应用安装、游戏

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Channels Ads
English: Channels Ads | In-feed video in WeChat Channels | Video reach, livestream promotion, product discovery
Chinese: 视频号广告 | 视频号信息流中的视频 | 视频声量、直播预热、商品种草

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Search Ads
English: Search Ads | Keyword results in WeChat Search | Intent-based targeting, brand protection
Chinese: 搜一搜广告 | 微信搜索的关键词结果 | 意图型定向、品牌词保护

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Top Stories Ads
English: Top Stories Ads | In the curated content feed | Article discovery, content promotion
Chinese: 看一看广告 | 看一看推荐信息流 | 文章分发、内容推广

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'The six ad placements' / 2
English: Channels is the one to watch. Daily active users on WeChat Channels exceeded 800 million in 2025 according to Tencent's own reporting, and Channels ad revenue grew 60% year-over-year in 2024. It is still relatively underpriced compared to Moments, which makes it a strong option for brands looking for video reach without Moments-level budgets.
Chinese: 视频号是真正要盯紧的那个。根据腾讯官方数据，2025年视频号日活突破8亿，2024年视频号广告收入同比增长60%。目前相较朋友圈仍然明显被低估，对想要视频声量但又没有朋友圈级预算的品牌来说，是一个非常值得切入的位置。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H2 – How pricing works
English: How pricing works
Chinese: 价格怎么算

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'How pricing works'
English: WeChat uses three pricing models. The right one depends mostly on how much you want to spend and what you are trying to get out of it.
Chinese: 微信有三种计价方式。选哪一种主要看你要花多少钱、想拿到什么结果。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H3 – CPM: pay per 1,000 impressions
English: CPM: pay per 1,000 impressions
Chinese: CPM：千次曝光计费

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'CPM' / 1
English: The most common model for Moments ads and brand campaigns. Rates vary by city tier and by how you buy.
Chinese: 朋友圈广告和品牌活动里最常见的方式。价格按城市分级、按下单方式浮动。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Core tier
English: Core (Beijing, Shanghai) | Around 150 yuan per thousand | 100-300 yuan per thousand
Chinese: 核心（北京、上海） | 约150元/千次 | 100-300元/千次

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Key tier
English: Key (Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Hangzhou and 18 others) | Around 100 yuan per thousand | 60-200 yuan per thousand
Chinese: 重点（广州、深圳、成都、杭州等22城） | 约100元/千次 | 60-200元/千次

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Standard tier
English: Standard (all other cities) | Around 50 yuan per thousand | 30-200 yuan per thousand
Chinese: 标准（其他城市） | 约50元/千次 | 30-200元/千次

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'CPM' / 2
English: Video ads cost roughly 30-50% more than image ads at the same impression level. For context, Douyin's paid traffic CPM through Ocean Engine runs 30-60 yuan, but that is for amplification of existing content, not native feed placement. WeChat Moments CPM is higher because you are buying placement inside a personal social feed with much higher trust signals.
Chinese: 视频素材的CPM大概比图片素材高30%-50%。作为对照，抖音巨量引擎的付费流量CPM在30-60元，但那是已有内容的付费放量，不是原生信息流广告位。朋友圈CPM更高，因为你买的是进入一个信任度更高的社交信息流的入场券。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Source under 'CPM'
English: Source: Zhihu, industry benchmarks
Chinese: 来源：知乎，行业基准

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H3 – CPC: pay per click
English: CPC: pay per click
Chinese: CPC：按点击计费

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'CPC'
English: Common for Official Account article ads and Mini Program banners. The floor is low: article-bottom ads start at around 0.5 yuan per click. But Moments CPC is a different story, running 2-20 yuan depending on how tight your targeting is and how many other brands are bidding for the same audience. For comparison, Baidu search ads average 2-15 yuan per click. The difference is that WeChat clicks come from users in a social context, not a search context. That changes how you should think about what a click is worth.
Chinese: 公众号文章广告和小程序横幅常用。起步价不高：文章底部广告大约0.5元起一次点击。但朋友圈CPC就是另一回事了，2-20元不等，要看定向精细度和同一人群里有多少品牌在抢。作为对照，百度搜索广告平均2-15元一次点击。差别在于，微信的点击来自社交情境，不是搜索情境，这会改变你对一次点击到底值多少钱的判断。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Source under 'CPC'
English: Source: Yiban, Zhihu
Chinese: 来源：一半，知乎

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H3 – oCPM: smart bidding
English: oCPM: smart bidding
Chinese: oCPM：智能出价

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'oCPM'
English: WeChat's AI-powered model. You set a target conversion cost and the system adjusts your bid in real time to reach users most likely to take action. In 2025, Tencent added new AI bidding tools that cut costs by an estimated 10-15% compared to manual bidding. Once you have enough conversion data flowing in, most advertisers on WeChat gradually shift to oCPM. It takes a few weeks to build up the data the algorithm needs, but after that it tends to outperform manual bidding consistently.
Chinese: 微信的AI出价模型。你设定目标转化成本，系统实时调整出价，去找最可能下单的用户。2025年腾讯加了新的AI出价工具，据说能在人工出价基础上把成本再降10%-15%。跑通一段时间、数据积累够了之后，大部分在微信投放的广告主都会逐步切到oCPM。建模需要几周，但之后的表现通常会稳定地超过人工出价。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Source under 'oCPM'
English: Source: Yiban
Chinese: 来源：一半

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H2 – Minimum spend: what you actually need to start
English: Minimum spend: what you actually need to start
Chinese: 最低预算：真正要备多少钱

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'Minimum spend' / 1
English: This is where a lot of brands get tripped up. The minimums depend entirely on your buying method.
Chinese: 这是很多品牌过不去的坎。起投门槛取决于你怎么下单。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Scheduled buy
English: Scheduled buy | 50,000 yuan per campaign (around $7,000)
Chinese: 合约下单 | 每场活动5万元起（约合7000美元）

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Bidding buy
English: Bidding buy | 1,000 yuan top-up, 1,000 yuan per day budget
Chinese: 竞价下单 | 账户充值1000元，每日预算1000元起

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Table row – Local promotion
English: Local promotion | 300 yuan per day (around $42)
Chinese: 本地推广 | 每天300元起（约合42美元）

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'Minimum spend' / 2
English: The 50,000 yuan scheduled buy is designed for larger brand pushes. You lock in guaranteed impressions 1-28 days in advance. Think product launches, seasonal campaigns, or major events. It is a "pay now, guarantee eyeballs" model.
Chinese: 5万元的合约下单是为大型品牌活动设计的。你可以提前1-28天锁定保量曝光。适合新品发布、节日campaign或大活动。本质是"先付钱，曝光给你兜底"。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Source under 'Minimum spend'
English: Source: Niaoge Biji, Digitaling
Chinese: 来源：鸟哥笔记，Digitaling

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'Minimum spend' / 3
English: For international brands testing the waters, the bidding model at 1,000 yuan per day is the most practical starting point. You control daily spend, adjust targeting in real time, and only pay for impressions or clicks that actually happen.
Chinese: 对想先试水的国际品牌来说，每日1000元预算的竞价是最实用的起点。日预算自己控，定向随时调，只为真实的曝光或点击付钱。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'Minimum spend' / 4
English: Local promotion at 300 yuan per day is the cheapest entry point but only works for geo-targeted campaigns within 3-5 km of a physical location. Good for restaurants, retail stores, or event venues. Not useful for national brand campaigns.
Chinese: 本地推广一天300元是最低的入口，但只适合离实体位置3-5公里范围内的地理定向。餐厅、零售店、活动现场合适，全国性品牌campaign用不上。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H2 – Practical things nobody tells you
English: Practical things nobody tells you
Chinese: 没人告诉你的几个细节

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Bullet under 'Practical things' / 1
English: Creative review is strict and slow. WeChat rejects ads with exaggerated claims, unverified statistics, health promises without government certification, or anything that encourages sharing or forwarding. Review takes 1-2 business days. Build that into your campaign timeline or you will miss your launch window.
Chinese: 审核严格而且慢。微信对夸大宣传、未经核实的数据、未取得政府认证的健康承诺、鼓励分享转发的内容一律驳回。审核需要1-2个工作日。这段时间要算进排期里，不然就错过上线窗口。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Bullet under 'Practical things' / 2
English: Moments ads compete with real people. This is not a banner on a website. Your ad shows up between photos of someone's kid and their coworker's vacation. If it does not look and feel like something a person would actually post, people will scroll past in half a second.
Chinese: 朋友圈广告和真人抢位置。这不是挂在网页上的banner。你的广告会夹在某个人的孩子照片和同事的度假vlog中间。如果它不像一个人会发的东西，别人会在半秒内划过。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Bullet under 'Practical things' / 3
English: One creative swap per campaign. WeChat allows you to update your Moments ad creative up to three times per month, but each change goes through review again. Plan your creative upfront.
Chinese: 一场campaign只能换一次素材。微信允许你每月最多更换三次朋友圈广告素材，但每次都要重新走审核。素材规划前期一次做到位。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Bullet under 'Practical things' / 4
English: Peak hours cost more. Bidding during evening prime time (7-9 PM) costs 20-40% more than off-peak. If your budget is tight, test daytime slots first.
Chinese: 高峰时段更贵。晚间黄金时段（19-21点）的竞价比非高峰时段贵20%-40%。如果预算紧，先测白天时段。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Source under 'Practical things'
English: Source: Aiyong Tech
Chinese: 来源：爱用科技

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / H2 – The bottom line
English: The bottom line
Chinese: 最后一句话

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Blockquote under 'The bottom line'
English: WeChat advertising is not cheap. But for brands that need to reach Chinese consumers inside a trusted, closed ecosystem, nothing else comes close.
Chinese: 微信广告不便宜。但如果你要在一个封闭的高信任度生态里触达中国消费者，没有哪个平台比它更合适。

Location: Blog / WeChat Advertising: Formats & Costs / Paragraph under 'The bottom line' / 1
English: Moments works best for awareness. Official Account ads are better for content-led conversion. Channels gives you video reach at a lower price point than Moments. And Search captures people who are already looking for something specific. Start with bidding to test what is working, then scale into scheduled buys once you have the data.

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'The problem it solves' / 1
English: In China, business relationships live on WeChat. Your sales associates, account managers, and support staff are all talking to clients there. Chinese: 在中国，商业关系跑在微信上。销售、客户经理、客服，每天都在微信里和客户聊。问题在于，如果用的是个人微信，联系人归个人。不归公司。一旦人走了，客户关系也跟着走。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Blockquote under 'The problem it solves'
English: If someone quits, the client relationships walk out the door with them. The brand is left starting over.
Chinese: 人一离职，客户就跟着被带走。品牌只能从头再来。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'The problem it solves' / 2
English: This is not a small risk. It happens all the time. For international brands still building their name in China, losing a key account manager can mean starting over with clients who barely knew your brand to begin with.
Chinese: 这不是小概率事件，在国内是家常便饭。对在中国还在打品牌知名度的国际品牌，一个关键客户经理走人，很可能意味着要从零开始面对那些根本没记住你是谁的客户。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'The problem it solves' / 3
English: WeCom puts the company in control. All contacts sit under the corporate account. Conversations are logged and transferable. When someone leaves, their entire client portfolio moves to the next person automatically.
Chinese: WeCom把主动权交回到公司手上。所有客户都挂在企业账号下。聊天记录全部留痕、可交接。员工离职，整个客户名册自动转移给接手的人。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'The problem it solves' / 4
English: There is also a trust element. When a customer adds a WeCom contact, they see a verified company name and employee title. For international brands that Chinese consumers have not heard of, that kind of credibility is hard to get any other way.
Chinese: 还有一层信任的价值。客户加上WeCom好友时，看到的是经过认证的公司名称和员工职位。对中国消费者没听过的国际品牌来说，这种可信度很难从别的渠道拿到。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Table row – Direct messaging

Chinese: 一对一聊天 | 销售直接在客户的普通微信里和客户聊天，不是群发，不是公众号推文。打开率要高得多

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Table row – 50,000 contacts
English: 50,000 contacts | A personal WeChat caps at 5,000. WeCom allows 10x that. Group chats scale to 10,000 members vs. WeChat's 500.
Chinese: 5万好友上限 | 个人微信好友上限5000，WeCom能加到它的十倍。客户群最多能拉到1万人，普通微信群上限只有500

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Table row – CRM integration
English: CRM integration | Connects with Salesforce, HubSpot, JingSocial, Fxiaoke. Purchase history, chat logs, and browsing data in one dashboard.
Chinese: CRM集成 | 对接Salesforce、HubSpot、JINGdigital、纷享销客。购买记录、聊天日志、浏览行为都能汇到一个后台

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Table row – Company Moments
English: Company Moments | Brands post to customers' WeChat feeds through employees' WeCom accounts. Free, high-reach, and right in the daily scroll.
Chinese: 企业朋友圈 | 品牌通过员工的WeCom账号发到客户朋友圈里。免费、触达高、直接出现在日常刷动态的场景里

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Table row – WeChat Pay
English: WeChat Pay | Sales associates process payments inside the chat, tied to the corporate account. Everything tracked.
Chinese: 微信支付 | 销售在聊天里直接收款，全部挂在企业账号下，全流程可追踪

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Table row – WeCom 5.0 and AI
English: WeCom 5.0 and AI | Smart Search, automated summaries, AI chatbots. Plus an Overseas Edition with multilingual support for 100+ countries.
Chinese: WeCom 5.0 和 AI | 智能搜索、自动摘要、AI聊天机器人。还有海外版，支持100多个国家的多语言能力

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'What WeCom actually does' / 2

Chinese: 过去一年，WeCom团队发布了12个版本更新、超过1700项功能改进。

Chinese: "私域流量"这个词在中国之外的营销圈几乎没人用。但在中国，它是品牌增长的核心概念。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'Private domain traffic' / 2

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'Private domain traffic' / 3
English: Public traffic is paid ads and algorithm-driven feeds on Douyin or RedNote. You pay for eyeballs. When you stop paying, they are gone.
Chinese: 公域流量 指的是付费广告和抖音、小红书这类平台的算法信息流。你花钱买注意力。钱一停，人就没了。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Blockquote under 'Private domain traffic' / 1

English: Private domain traffic is the channels you own. WeChat groups, Mini Programs, Official Accounts, WeCom contacts. Once customers are there, you reach them directly. No ad spend. No algorithm deciding who sees your message.
Chinese: 私域流量 指的是你自己拥有的渠道。微信群、小程序、公众号、WeCom联系人。客户一旦进来，你就能直接触达。不用投广告，不看算法脸色。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'Private domain traffic' / 5
English: WeCom is the tool that makes this work at scale. A customer discovers your brand on Douyin. Your team moves them into WeCom. From there, it is direct communication, personalized offers, and repeat purchases without paying for reach every single time.
Chinese: WeCom是让这套玩法规模化的关键工具。客户在抖音看到你的品牌。你的团队把他引到WeCom。然后就是直接沟通、个性化offer、做复购，不用每次都为流量买单。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'Private domain traffic' / 6
English: The private domain traffic market in China continues to expand rapidly as public traffic costs keep rising and brands prioritize direct customer relationships.
Chinese: 公域流量成本持续走高、品牌越来越重视直接的客户关系，中国的私域流量市场还在快速扩张。

Chinese: 平台本身是免费的。真正要投入的是那一套把联系人变成营收的工作流，以及训练你的团队把它跑起来。

Chinese: 绕过WeCom的品牌等于把钱扔在桌上。每一分广告费带进来的客户，你都留不住、触达不到、第二次复购还得再付一次广告费。

Location: Blog / What is WeCom / Paragraph under 'The bottom line'
English: Without it, you are paying for attention you never get to keep.
Chinese: 没有WeCom，你买到的注意力，永远留不下来。

Chinese: 为什么直播购物在中国这么吃香

English: China's livestream e-commerce market hit 5.8 trillion yuan in 2024. Here are the five reasons Chinese shoppers prefer buying through livestreams.
Chinese: 2024年中国直播电商市场规模达到5.8万亿元。从消费者的角度看，为什么他们更愿意在直播间下单。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Intro italic
English: Nearly 600 million Chinese consumers now buy through livestreams. The market hit 5.8 trillion yuan in 2024. To understand why, you have to see it from the shopper's side.
Chinese: 将近6亿中国消费者正在通过直播间下单。2024年市场交易规模达到5.8万亿元。想看清楚它是怎么跑起来的，必须站到买家那一边。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / H2 – The scale of it
English: The scale of it
Chinese: 体量有多大

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'The scale of it' / 1
English: Livestream shopping in China is mainstream. It is how a huge chunk of the population buys things now.
Chinese: 直播电商在中国已经是大众行为。它已经是很大一部分人"买东西"的主要方式。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'The scale of it' / 2
English: How big is it? iResearch puts the market at 5.8 trillion yuan in 2024. User penetration went from 4.9% in 2019 to 37.8% in 2024, bringing the total to close to 600 million regular livestream shoppers. In 2023 alone, Chinese platforms hosted over 110 million livestream sessions featuring more than 70 million products, with over 2.7 million active hosts.
Chinese: 究竟有多大？艾瑞咨询给出的数据是2024年5.8万亿元。用户渗透率从2019年的4.9%涨到2024年的37.8%，接近6亿人成为常态直播购物者。仅2023年一年，中国各平台一共举办了1.1亿多场直播，带货商品超过7000万件，活跃主播超过270万。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Source under 'The scale of it' / 1
English: Source: CIECC, Livestream E-commerce High-Quality Development Report 2024
Chinese: 来源：中国国际电子商务中心，《2024直播电商高质量发展报告》

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'The scale of it' / 3
English: And this is not passive viewing. According to iiMedia Research, 79.32% of short video and livestream users have made a purchase through the platform. Over 55% of regular viewers buy at least once a month. Only 15.5% of viewers say they watch purely for entertainment with no purchase intent.
Chinese: 而且这不是"围观"式观看。艾媒咨询的数据显示，79.32%的短视频和直播用户在平台上下过单。超过55%的常客每月至少买一次。只有15.5%的观众说自己纯粹是来娱乐、没打算买东西的。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Source under 'The scale of it' / 2
English: Source: iiMedia Research; China Consumers Association
Chinese: 来源：艾媒咨询；中国消费者协会

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'The scale of it' / 4
English: That is not a trend. It is a fundamental shift in how Chinese consumers shop.
Chinese: 这不是趋势。这是中国消费者买东西方式的一次底层切换。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / H2 – Why shoppers prefer it: five reasons
English: Why shoppers prefer it: five reasons
Chinese: 买家为什么偏爱它：五个原因

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'Why shoppers prefer it'
English: The easy explanation is "it is entertaining." And sure, that is part of it. But if entertainment were the whole story, people would watch and not buy. The real reasons go deeper than that.
Chinese: 最容易的解释是"有意思"。这当然是一部分。但如果娱乐是全部原因，大家就只看不买了。真正的原因比这更深。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / H3 – 1. They can see the product for real
English: 1. They can see the product for real
Chinese: 1. 能真正看到产品

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'They can see the product for real' / 1
English: Anyone who has ever bought something online based on a photo knows the feeling when it arrives and looks nothing like the listing. Livestreaming cuts through that. The host holds the product, demonstrates it, tries it on, tests it live. According to iiMedia Research survey data, 59.89% of livestream shoppers say the main reason they prefer livestreaming over traditional e-commerce is that product presentation is more direct and authentic.
Chinese: 在网上看着照片下单、拿到货发现完全不是那回事的经历，大家都有过。直播把这个坑填掉了。主播把产品拿在手上演示、试穿、现场测试。艾媒咨询的调研数据显示，59.89%的直播购物者选择直播而不是传统电商，最大的原因就是产品呈现更直接、更真实。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'They can see the product for real' / 2
English: The China Consumers Association found that the top three reasons consumers prefer livestream shopping, accounting for 83.9% of responses combined, are: the ability to create an immersive buying atmosphere, stronger interactivity, and the fact that products appear more real and tangible.
Chinese: 中国消费者协会的调查发现，消费者喜欢直播购物的前三个原因合计占比83.9%，分别是：沉浸式的购物氛围、更强的互动感、以及商品看起来更真实可感。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / H3 – 2. They get answers instantly
English: 2. They get answers instantly
Chinese: 2. 问题立刻有答案

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'They get answers instantly'
English: In a livestream, shoppers type questions into the chat and the host responds in real time. Does this run small? What is the fabric like? Is this safe for sensitive skin? This kind of real-time back-and-forth simulates talking to a salesperson in a physical store. Except you are doing it from your couch at 10 PM. That combination of convenience and human contact is extremely hard to replicate with product pages and chatbots.
Chinese: 直播间里，观众把问题打进弹幕，主播当场回答。"这款偏小码吗？""面料什么手感？""敏感肌能用吗？"这种实时来回像回到了线下门店和销售对话的场景。差别只是你在自己家的沙发上，而且是晚上十点。便利加上人情味，静态商品页和聊天机器人几乎学不来。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Source under 'They get answers instantly'
English: Source: Commercial Economy Research; Cankao Wang, 2025
Chinese: 来源：商业经济研究；参考网，2025

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / H3 – 3. The prices are genuinely lower
English: 3. The prices are genuinely lower
Chinese: 3. 价格是真的便宜

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'The prices are genuinely lower'
English: This is not just perception. Brands offer livestream-exclusive discounts, bundle deals, and limited-time coupons that are not available on the regular product page. During the 2024 618 festival, livestream e-commerce sales reached 206.8 billion yuan, up 12.1% year-over-year. A large portion of that growth came from price-conscious shoppers waiting for livestream-only deals.
Chinese: 这不是一种"感觉"。品牌会在直播间给出专属折扣、组合包、限时券，产品详情页上是拿不到的。2024年618期间，直播电商销售额达到2068亿元，同比增长12.1%，其中很大一部分增量来自那些专门等直播专属价的精打细算派。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'They trust the host' / 1
English: The best livestream hosts in China are not salespeople. They are educators and trusted advisors. Oriental Selection built its brand around former teachers who explain products with humor, depth, and genuine expertise. Viewers come back to the same host not just for deals but because the relationship feels personal.
Chinese: 中国做得最好的直播主播，不是销售。他们是有信服力的老师和顾问。东方甄选就是靠前老师们幽默、有深度、有专业积累的讲解立的品牌。观众一次次回到同一个直播间，不只是为了折扣，是因为那种关系变得像朋友。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'They trust the host' / 2
English: According to the China Consumers Association survey, nearly 70% of livestream shoppers say they will buy a product if the host recommends it and they like it. Another 22.7% say they will buy in most cases when the host recommends something. Try getting those numbers from a product detail page.
Chinese: 中国消费者协会的调查显示，近70%的直播购物者说，只要主播推荐、自己喜欢，就会下单。另有22.7%的人说大多数情况下会下单。产品详情页永远做不到这个数字。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / H3 – 5. Social proof is happening live
English: 5. Social proof is happening live
Chinese: 5. 社交背书是现场发生的

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'Social proof is happening live'
English: When hundreds of people buy the same product in real time and the chat fills with "just ordered" and "already received mine from last time," it changes how you feel about pressing the buy button yourself. Research from Tsinghua University found that the "purchase atmosphere" in a livestream room, created by visible real-time transactions and peer comments, is a distinct driver of impulse buying behavior. Flash sales, countdown timers, and visible purchase volume create a fear-of-missing-out dynamic that static e-commerce simply cannot generate.
Chinese: 几百个人同时在买同一件商品，弹幕里一直刷"刚下单了""上次买的已经到货了"，你会在那一下子对"要不要按下单键"产生不一样的感觉。清华大学的研究发现，直播间里由实时成交和弹幕评论共同制造出的"购买氛围"，是冲动下单行为的一个独立驱动因素。限时抢、倒计时、可见的成交数，创造出一种静态电商根本做不出来的"怕错过"的紧迫感。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / H2 – What this means for brands
English: What this means for brands
Chinese: 这对品牌意味着什么

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'What this means for brands' / 1
English: Whether you are a Chinese brand trying to outperform competitors, an international brand already selling here, or a new entrant testing the waters, livestream shopping is not optional. It is the single largest conversion channel in Chinese e-commerce.
Chinese: 不管你是一个想在竞争中领跑的中国品牌，是一个已经在国内卖货的国际品牌，还是一个正在试水的新入局者，直播电商都不再是"可选项"。它已经是中国电商里最大的一个转化渠道。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'What this means for brands' / 2
English: Understanding the shopper's mindset is the first step. They want to see the product demonstrated live. They want to ask questions and get immediate answers. They want a genuinely good price. They want to trust the person selling. And they want to see other people buying it at the same time.
Chinese: 看懂买家的心态是第一步。他们要看产品被真人演示。他们要问问题、立刻得到回答。他们要一个真的好价格。他们要相信卖东西给自己的那个人。他们要看到别人也在同一时刻买。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'What this means for brands' / 3
English: For Chinese brands, the opportunity is in doing it better than everyone else. The format is familiar but most brands still run generic, low-effort livestreams. The ones investing in host quality, content strategy, and private domain follow-up are the ones pulling ahead.
Chinese: 对中国品牌来说，机会在于怎么把这件事做得比别人更好。这个形式已经普及了，但多数品牌开的还是套模板、低精力的直播。那些真正投入主播质量、内容策略和私域承接的品牌，已经拉开距离。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Paragraph under 'What this means for brands' / 4
English: For international brands, the opportunity is access. Livestreaming lets you test products, gather real consumer feedback, and build trust faster than any other channel available in China right now.
Chinese: 对国际品牌来说，机会在于入口。直播间让你能更快地测试产品、拿到真实的消费者反馈、在中国建立信任。比其他任何渠道都快。

Location: Blog / Why Livestream Shopping Took Over China / Blockquote under 'What this means for brands'
English: A well-run livestream can meet all of those needs at once. A static product page cannot come close. And that is why this format keeps growing.
Chinese: 一场跑得好的直播可以同时满足上面所有这些需求。静态商品页一条都做不到。这就是为什么这种形式还会继续涨下去。
